faq_heading: New construction in Whalley: your questions answered

faq.q: What have condos in Whalley sold for?
faq.a: 520 condos sold in Whalley at a median of $417,000, with the middle half between $360,000 and $503,125.

faq.q: How long do homes take to sell in Whalley?
faq.a: In Whalley, houses were quickest at 28 days at a median, and townhomes slowest at 46 days.

faq.q: Which homes in Whalley are the newest?
faq.a: Of the homes that resold in Whalley, condos had the newest median build year, 2019.

blocks.text: What you see above is a live MLS® search for Whalley: active houses, townhomes and condos with an age of 0 or less, so this year's completions and homes still being built. items.t: In Whalley, houses sold at a median of $1,305,000 across 26 sales, and the middle half closed between $1,105,000 and $1,637,500. The median house sat 28 days and sold for 95.4% of list.
Whalley: 25 townhomes sold at a median of $620,000, with the middle half between $565,000 and $685,000. The median townhome took 46 days to sell and closed at 97.1% of list.
520 condos sold in Whalley at a median of $417,000 (middle half $360,000 to $503,125). A typical condo in Whalley spent 30 days on the market and closed at 96.9% of the asking price.

blocks.text: Source: Paragon closed sales, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026; medians need 5 or more sales.
How Whalley compares with the rest of North Surrey

items.t: Of 7 North Surrey sub-areas with 5 or more house sales, Whalley ranks second highest at $1,305,000; the range is $1,040,000 (Bridgeview) to $1,559,000 (Fraser Heights). Guildford ($1,145,000) sits just below and Fraser Heights ($1,559,000) sits just above.
Townhomes in Whalley have the lowest median of the 5 North Surrey sub-areas, $620,000, below Guildford at $640,000; the highest is Fraser Heights at $925,000.

Of 4 North Surrey sub-areas with 5 or more condo sales, Whalley ranks second lowest at $417,000; the range is $325,900 (Cedar Hills) to $495,500 (Guildford). Cedar Hills ($325,900) sits just below and Bolivar Heights ($460,000) sits just above.

blocks.text: By build year, condos are the newest homes selling in Whalley (median 2019) and houses the oldest (median 1990), a gap of 29 years.
